categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Adds a new `IsSymlink` filesystem helper in `src/util/fs_helpers.cpp` and `src/util/fs_helpers.h` to work around MinGW/GCC `libstdc++` limitations on Windows.
categories.rationale: Adds a platform-specific filesystem primitive to correctly detect symlinks on Windows. While useful shared infrastructure, the utility function is straightforward and primarily created to serve wallet path checks.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label, modifies `src/wallet/db.cpp` and `src/wallet/wallet.cpp`, and updates `test/functional/wallet_multiwallet.py`.
categories.rationale: Fixes Windows wallet path resolution where missing symlink detection causes `ListDatabases` to recursively traverse symlinked directories and `GetWalletPath` to treat symlinks as regular files. This resolves an ongoing platform inconsistency that previously required disabling multiwallet symlink tests on Windows.
